#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class NumberTheory {
public:
    class Mod998;
};

class NumberTheory::Mod998 {
public:
    static const long long MOD = 998244353;

    vector<int> factorial;
    vector<int> invFactorial;

    Mod998() {
        factorial.push_back(1);
        invFactorial.push_back(1);
    }

    long long fact(int n) {
        while ((int)factorial.size() <= n) {
            factorial.push_back((int)mult(factorial.back(), (int)factorial.size()));
        }
        return factorial[n];
    }

    long long fInv(int n) {
        int lastKnown = (int)invFactorial.size() - 1;
        if (lastKnown < n) {
            int len = n - lastKnown;
            vector<long long> fInv(len);
            fInv[0] = inv(fact(n));
            for (int i = 1; i < len; i++) {
                fInv[i] = mult(fInv[i-1], n - i + 1);
            }
            for (int i = len - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                invFactorial.push_back((int)fInv[i]);
            }
        }
        return invFactorial[n];
    }

    long long paritySign(long long k) {
        return (k & 1) == 0 ? 1 : MOD - 1;
    }

    long long ncr(int n, int r) {
        if (r < 0 || n < r) return 0;
        return mult(fact(n), mult(fInv(r), fInv(n - r)));
    }

    long long smallInv(int n) {
        return mult(fInv(n), fact(n-1));
    }

    long long normalize(long long x) {
        x %= MOD;
        if (x < 0) x += MOD;
        return x;
    }

    long long add(long long a, long long b) {
        long long v = a + b;
        return v < MOD ? v : v - MOD;
    }

    long long mult(long long a, long long b) {
        return (a * b) % MOD;
    }

    long long mult(initializer_list<long long> args) {
        long long r = 1;
        for (long long x : args) r = mult(r, x);
        return r;
    }

    long long div(long long a, long long b) {
        return mult(a, inv(b));
    }

    long long inv(long long value) {
        long long g = MOD, x = 0, y = 1;
        for (long long r = value; r != 0; ) {
            long long q = g / r;
            g %= r;
            swap(g, r);
            x -= q * y;
            swap(x, y);
        }
        return normalize(x);
    }
};

class InputReader {
public:
    BufferedReader reader;
    StringTokenizer tokenizer;

    InputReader(istream& stream) : reader(stream) {
        tokenizer = nullptr;
    }

    string next() {
        while (tokenizer == nullptr || !tokenizer.hasNext()) {
            tokenizer = new StringTokenizer(reader.readLine());
        }
        return tokenizer.nextToken();
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }
};

class StringTokenizer {
public:
    string str;
    size_t pos;

    StringTokenizer(const string& s) : str(s), pos(0) {}

    bool hasNext() {
        while (pos < str.size() && isspace(str[pos])) pos++;
        return pos < str.size();
    }

    string nextToken() {
        while (pos < str.size() && isspace(str[pos])) pos++;
        size_t start = pos;
        while (pos < str.size() && !isspace(str[pos])) pos++;
        return str.substr(start, pos - start);
    }
};

class BufferedReader {
public:
    istream& stream;
    string buffer;

    BufferedReader(istream& s) : stream(s) {}

    string readLine() {
        getline(stream, buffer);
        return buffer;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    InputReader in(cin);
    NumberTheory::Mod998 mod;

    int n = in.nextInt();
    int m = in.nextInt();

    mod.fInv(n + m);

    long long phaseSize = 1;
    long long p = 1;
    for (int i = 0; p != 0; i++) {
        p = mod.mult(p, n - i);
        p = mod.mult(p, mod.smallInv(n + m - i));
        phaseSize = mod.add(phaseSize, p);
    }

    long long answer = 0;
    for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
        long long sign = mod.paritySign(k + 1);
        long long numPhases = mod.div(m + k, k);
        long long term = mod.mult({sign, mod.ncr(n, k), numPhases, phaseSize});
        answer = mod.add(answer, term);
    }

    cout << answer << '\n';
    return 0;
}
